Автоматический режим объединяет абзацы в: Auto mode packs paragraphs within the budget. Paragraph mode sends each paragraph separately. Long paragraphs split at lines and words; truncated responses trigger another split.
0 — заполнение доступного контекста. Мен: 0 fills available context. A lower target makes smaller fragments and may help a small model focus on details. Instructions and fragment context count toward this limit.
Бюджет заголовков документа и таблицы, д: Budget for document and table headings attached to fragments. They preserve meaning across fragments. 0 disables this additional context.
Верхняя граница списка находок в JSON. Е: Maximum JSON findings. When a response reaches this many distinct grounded values, the fragment is checked in smaller parts for omissions.
Защитный предел, включая повторы на мень: Safety limit including retries on smaller fragments. At the limit, findings remain available for review and the job can be retried.
Общий бюджет входа и ответа на одно обра: Total input and output budget per request. Local models use their own tokenizer. Larger contexts need more memory; select a size your model supports. APIs without a tokenizer use a conservative UTF-8 byte bound for planning.
Место, заранее отведённое под JSON-ответ: Space reserved for the JSON response before splitting input. Truncated discovery requests are retried on smaller fragments.
Дополнительный запас между входом и лими: Additional margin between input and the output limit. Output limit plus reserve must be smaller than context.
Число значений для одного обращения при: Values in a review or categorization request. Increase for a stronger model when context and output budgets allow.
Расход токенов и причины завершения обра: Token usage and request finish reasons. Truncations followed by successful smaller-fragment checks remain in this log.
Вход и лимит ответа превышают контекст м: Input plus output limit exceeds model context. Reduce input or increase context in advanced settings.
Лимит ответа и резерв должны помещаться: Output limit and reserve must fit within model context.
